node.statement: There are universal D_3 < infinity and e_3 > 0, with e_3 <= a_merge/(C_cross+1), such that every amplified four-corner datum in A_R with common defect rho <= C_cross*t and target ambient defect epsilon_{A_R} <= t <= e_3 satisfies rho + epsilon_{A_R} <= a_merge and yields an extended D_3*t-isomorphism B_U oplus B_V -> A_R.
